title: Cognitra Offer
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm install && npm run build'

checks.reduced_motion: passed; heading visible without entrance animation
checks.visual_review: passed; desktop and mobile screenshots inspected

notes: Implemented only the supplied Cognitra Offer design with React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS 3, and Framer Motion 12.

Original font CSS import retained, with a local font declaration for resilience.
Mobile screenshot is full-page, captured at viewport 390x844.
Chromium tested; Safari and Firefox untested.
